paragraphs.text: The Beamtown Bullies are a gang of legendary warriors consisting of an Ogre , two Devils , and possibly a fourth person from Capenna .

The Beamtown Bullies are a Riveteers gang on New Capenna . The members include a large ogre warrior dressed like a construction worker who wields a large metal beam. A pair of devils with daggers and a fourth member of unknown peerage.
